lesson.subtitle: Lesson 17 -- What Did You Do? Telling What Happened
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Joice Lopes Leite | Lesson 17 -- What Did You Do?

listenings.text: Hello, everybody. Here is a short summary of last month. We organized two meetings and one technical session. Joice visited four public schools and wrote the report about the platform. Marina travelled to Recife and met the team there. We did not finish the data about small schools, and that is our first subject today. Peter said one important thing last week: we need more time with the teachers. Please read the summary before we start. Thank you.

Hi, this is a quick message about the event last year. I went to Belém in November and I spoke in a small room, like you this year. I did not use slides, only three photos, and it was fine. Nobody asked a difficult question, and everybody was very kind. I remember one thing: I prepared much more than necessary. Do not do that. Prepare three minutes, and then rest. See you soon.

extra_audio.text: Joice opened her notebook on Monday morning. She organized the notes of the last four visits. She decided to write only one page. She finished the report on Wednesday. She sent it to the team and went to the meeting.

lesson.grammar_point: simple past regular and irregular (did / didn't)
